cohort: The study enrolled 274 neonates with clinically presumed sepsis, categorised into cases with proven or probable sepsis and controls with no-sepsis.
finding: Neonates with proven/probable sepsis and no-sepsis had comparable PI and PVI values in the first 120 hours, but non-survivors among neonates with sepsis had significantly lower PI values than survivors, though PI did not independently predict in-hospital mortality.
